owner_system: Downstream slide/report renderer and final document host; outside this repository.

surface_decides: actual layout family, theme, typography, spacing, pagination, and file format
brand-specific reference selection and renderer implementation
final export behaviour for PNG, PDF, PPTX, or equivalent deck formats
core_decides: argument beats and slide-level semantic partitioning
slide function, information topology, semantic fit, and bounded craft-reference requirements

constraints.consumption_mode: silent decision-support document; the deck should remain useful without a presenter
constraints.visible_text_density: medium to high when semantic fit passes; denser than a live presentation but never a license for unreadable text
constraints.evidence_density: medium-high to high when multiple evidence elements jointly support one dominant slide message
constraints.provenance: source lines, caveats, and material qualifications remain visible or otherwise resolvable from the artifact lineage
constraints.readability: desktop, print, and normal presentation-size inspection are primary; mobile-first readability is not assumed
constraints.planning_contract: Use skills/compile-slide-deck and schemas/slide-deck-plan.schema.json before brand-specific layout or rendering.
constraints.infographic_boundary: This profile does not govern single-canvas infographic/poster composition and must not change editorial/INFOGRAPHIC-AND-POSTER.md defaults.
constraints.style_boundary: No Samsung, consulting-firm, or other brand-specific colours, fonts, coordinates, layout families, or reference IDs are canonical here.

publication_boundary: This repository prepares the semantic deck plan only. Rendering, approval, export, and publication remain downstream human/project responsibilities.

replaceable.note: A different report renderer or brand adapter may consume the same SlideDeckPlan without changing canonical claims, slide functions, topology, or the infographic lane.
